notes: Pedestal or submersible 1/3 HP cast-iron — Zoeller M53, Wayne CDU800. Good for typical 1500 sqft basement.
1/2 HP for larger basements, deeper sumps, or higher water tables — Zoeller M267, Liberty 287
Standalone 12V DC backup — pumps when primary fails or power out. Wayne BGSP50, Basement Watchdog Big Dog
Best protection. Primary AC pump + DC backup in same basin. Most popular install pattern.
Uses municipal water pressure to pump — no electricity, no battery. Wastes ~1 gal per 2 gal pumped. Only with city water service.
Combo with WiFi alerts (Basement Watchdog Connect, Liberty SmartSump). Notifies via app for pump cycling, water level, battery state
Primary pump on a critical-loads circuit fed by generator transfer switch. Most reliable for long outages but $$ install.
